mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, o.supplier_id, o.supplier_name, o.expect_arrive_time, o.status, o.total_expect_qty, o.total_received_qty, o.remark, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM inbound_order o LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_no, warehouse_id, supplier_name, expect_arrive_time, status, total_expect_qty, total_received_qty, remark, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM inbound_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
